title: Automatic weekly event recommendations — which 10 events should appear on your website
body:
This module gathers the events in your area every week — festivals, village days, fairs,
concerts, running races —, and you choose which 10 should appear on your website.
You can reach this screen on the Modules tab, using the **„Setting”** link next to the module.

![Screenshot: the event recommendation selector on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## Where do the events come from?

Every Monday morning we go through the public event pages of the settlements within a 30 km radius
of your accommodation, and collect the events for the next two weeks. Every event shows its source:
tapping the link at the bottom of the row opens the page we took it from — so you can check it
before publishing.

Next to the settlement you can see how far it is from your accommodation. Events held in your own
settlement are marked **„On site”** — these are the most valuable for your guests.

If you have just purchased the module, we will collect the events in your area within about an hour —
until then, the **„Recommended activities”** column (on a phone, the **„Recommended”** tab) shows:
**„Collecting programs”**. In the meantime you can already add your own event with the
**„Add custom program”** button: after saving, your own events appear on your website
immediately, and the collected events will join them once gathered.

## Selecting

1. In the **„Recommended activities”** list, tap the **+** button next to an event.
2. The event moves into the **„On your site”** list.
3. You can choose up to 10 events. Once it is full, the other **+** buttons turn grey, and a
   warning appears — remove one with the **×** button if you want a different one instead.
4. Tap the **„Save to website”** button.

On a phone the two lists are on two tabs: the number in each tab label shows how many events are
in one list and the other.

## Order: by date by default

By default we list the selected events by date — every newly added event goes to its place
according to its date. Above the list this is indicated by the label **„by date”**.

If you want to move something up front, you can move it up and down with the arrows (▲ ▼) next to
the event. From then on your own order applies (the label: **„custom order”**), and whatever is at
the top will also come first on your website. With the **„sort by date”** link you can
return to date order at any time.

## Adding your own event

If you would like to recommend an event that we did not find — for example your own event —, you can
add it yourself:

1. Tap the **„Add custom program”** row at the top of the “On your site” list (or the
   **„Not on the list? Custom activity”** row at the bottom of the recommended events).
2. Enter the title of the event, and specify when it starts. If it lasts several days, also its end.
3. At the **„Where will it be?”** section, leave the “On site” choice if it will be in your own settlement;
   otherwise choose **„Elsewhere”** and enter the name of the settlement.
4. If the event has a website or a Facebook event, you can enter it in the **„Web address”** field — it
   is not required.
5. Tap the **„Add to page”** button, then the **„Save to website”** button.

Your own event is also one of the 10 slots. In the list it gets the **„Your recommendation”** mark, and on
your website, instead of the source, it says that the accommodation recommends it. You can modify or
delete it with the **„edit”** button below the event.

On the website, the events of the next two weeks are always shown. If you add your own event several
weeks in advance, the screen tells you from which day it will appear on your website. Expired own
events — like the others — are removed automatically.

## Rewriting the title

If an event’s name is too long or odd, you can rewrite it with the **„overwrite”** button below the
selected event. When done, tap the **„done”** button, then save. On your website the title you wrote
will appear.

## If you don’t choose

Your website will not stay empty: the nearest events are automatically placed in the free slots.
As soon as you make a choice, your choice comes to the front, and the automation only fills the
remaining slots.

## What happens weekly?

On Monday morning the list is refreshed, and you receive an email about how many events we found.
Your choice and order are preserved; expired events are removed from your website automatically —
you don’t need to deal with them.
